title: Woman Standing by Vintage Car, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot from around the 1940s featuring a middle-aged woman wearing a button-front shirtwaist dress with a belt, eyeglasses, and heels. She leans gently against the front fender and wheel of a vintage dark automobile. In the background, a peaceful rural setting with a small pond or river and rolling hills is visible under daylight.
